title: M/s Three Star Paper Mills Pvt. Ltd. v. State of U.P.
coram: Arun Tandon, J.; Akhtar Husain Khan, J.
disposition: Writ dismissed; petitioner relegated to Clause 7.10 statutory remedy.
headnote: A consumer seeking quashing of an electricity-bill order and a rebate must first use the statutory remedy under Clause 7.10 of the Electricity Supply Code, 2005. The writ was dismissed with liberty to pursue that forum.
facts: The petitioner paper mill filed a writ petition to quash an order dated 29.4.2014 and to obtain a direction for rebate on electricity bills. After hearing counsel for the petitioner and the Standing Counsel, the Division Bench noted a statutory remedy under the Electricity Supply Code, 2005, and did not examine the rebate claim or the contents of the impugned order on merits.

holding_units.holding: Where a consumer seeks quashing of an electricity-bill order and a rebate, Clause 7.10 of the Electricity Supply Code, 2005 is the statutory remedy; the writ petition is dismissed with liberty to pursue that forum.

not_decided.point: Merits of the 29.4.2014 order and the claim for rebate on electricity bills
not_decided.note: Writ dismissed solely for the Clause 7.10 remedy; no finding on the rebate or the impugned order.
